title: Fender Creates Special Pokemon Guitars
paragraphs: Pokémon fans who love music now have something special to look forward to. The famous guitar maker Fender has created two electric guitars to celebrate the 30th anniversary of Pokémon.
Fender made the guitars together with Pokémon Center, the official Pokémon store. The two companies announced them on October 30, 2026. Both guitars are made in Japan.

The guitars are based on the first Pokémon games, Pokémon Red and Pokémon Green, which came out in Japan for the Game Boy in 1996. One guitar is a Stratocaster called the "Red Version." The other is a Telecaster called the "Green Version." The Stratocaster and the Telecaster are two of Fender's most famous guitar models.

The guitars also have a fun feature. When players use one of the knobs on the guitar, they can turn on a special "8-bit" sound mode. This makes the guitar sound like the music from old video games. Fans can use it to play music from the classic Pokémon games.
The guitars also come with picks, which are used to play the strings. Ten of the picks show different Pokémon in pixel art, and the last one has the 30th anniversary logo.

However, the guitars are not cheap. Each one costs 396,000 yen. They are only sold in Japan through the Pokémon Center Online store. Because many people are expected to want them, buyers will be chosen by lottery. People can apply from November 19 to November 24, and the guitars are expected to be delivered in late December.
